_comment: Known-failing tests, recorded so the number can only go down.
The workflow used to run `npm test || echo "Tests failed"`, which exits 0
whatever happens -- so CI reported success on 2026-05-11 and since, over a
suite where 149 of 155 tests were failing. The cause is a single refactor:
the controllers standardised on utils/responseHelper (every success is now
{status, statusCode, message, data}, failures throw AppError) and the
assertions were never updated to match.
These are stale assertions, not 140 product bugs. Fix a suite, then lower
the numbers below -- the ratchet fails the build if they go up, and also if
they go down without this file being updated.
totalTests guards against a suite that stops loading: it contributes zero tests, so its failures disappear and the count looks like progress.
